lesson: Pick kernels add under products, so multiplying a control by Dirichlet polynomials with on-line zeros only delays its failure (149 to 210 with one factor, none to 256 with four distinct q). Powers of one factor barely help (221 at the 4096th power): new zero ordinates matter, not multiplicity. "DH passes orders 2 to 148" is certified only on the configurations run, not over all node sets; every configuration run here gave the same negative pivots. REFEREE.md is a same-agent second pass and counts as 0 referees.
